status.scientific: conditional interpretation and finite analytic countermodels

primitive: Readings of attributed declarations under a named model; no second cell, estimator or authority evaluator
statement: Known-incidence population identification, indistinguishability and similarity diversity are separate readings. No latent cause count is inferred from a source count, a pair matrix or a key/lineage label.

families.M3: Declared shared failure-factor incidence and oracle population moments; full-column-rank and positive correctness required; singleton/private decomposition unresolved
families.T5: Received latent-signal copy/noise summary; not the M3 model. Unknown-incidence recovery and nondegeneracy are not established by n>=2L or by M3 acceptance.
families.finiteCountermodels: Exact hand-specified probability tables; not a rerun of the campaign or an empirical causal inference

acceptance: known M3 incidence recovers existing exact parameters without finding the incidence
rank deficiency persists despite four sources and two declared factors
two laws have identical conditional pair marginals and different total information
private/singleton representations share moments and retain unresolved decomposition
one nondegenerate shared binary channel has normalized pair diversity 8/5 > declared shared count 1
doesNotEstablish: a universal information bound from pair similarity

informationBound.statement: I(Y;X)<=I(Y;S_1,...,S_L)<=sum_l I(Y;S_l); equals L*I_S only for a declared common signal information
conditions: Y -> (S_1,...,S_L) -> X is a declared Markov channel
Signals are mutually independent conditioned on Y
Finite variables and one joint prior
Equal I(Y;S_l) is needed for the L*I_S abbreviation
informationBound.formalization: written Shannon/data-processing derivation, not a Lean theorem

upperBoundCountermodel.scope: New exact three-source/two-signal model; not the missing received1.52/1.60 archive
